offering_description.value: Provides lease-to-own payment plans that let consumers take home furniture, electronics, appliances and other goods from retail and online merchant partners, with the company paying the merchant and collecting weekly or monthly lease payments from the consumer.

primary_services.value: lease-to-own financing; virtual lease-to-own checkout; lease payment and renewal management

customer_segment.value: B2C: consumers with limited access to traditional credit buying goods at retail or online

end_markets.value: consumer retail; e-commerce; furniture; consumer electronics; appliances

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: consumer lease payments for merchandise, with an option to own the item

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: funds merchandise purchases from merchant partners and collects lease payments from consumers

geography_served.value: US national: customers and merchant partners across the United States

specialization.value: niche specialist: lease-to-own payment solutions for consumer purchases

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: retail merchant partners offering in-store lease-to-own checkout; online: e-commerce merchant partners offering virtual lease-to-own checkout

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state consumer leasing laws and federal consumer finance rules overseen by the CFPB and state regulators

notes: Business mix and any divestitures may have changed; details reflect my best understanding of the main lease-to-own business.
